body.name: Paired-residual purification handle
body.construction: \(\mathsf{Purify}_R\) denotes the program that starts from a residual entry in \(\mathcal C_R\), applies a Singhal-style pure-profile decomposition jointly to the two subset-sum profiles toward \(\mathcal U_R\), preserves a common target fiber, and tracks the change in \(F\) and \(h\) through every elementary compression.
